jobs.occupation: Part-time Lecturers in International Business or Business & Government
jobs.description:
A number of positions as part-time lecturer in International Business and Business & Government respectively are available at the Department of International Economics, Government and Business (EGB) for appointment as soon as possible.

EGB is a multidisciplinary department, which conducts high-quality research in the fields of international business and political science with direct relevance to business, decision-makers and the broader public.

The department delivers research-based teaching into undergraduate and graduate teaching in programs such as International Business, International Business and Politics, and International Business in Asia. To learn more about the research and teaching activities of the department, please visit the departmental website here

As part-time lecturer you will have the opportunity to apply your knowledge to educate young people and to provide them with insight into your practical experience. At CBS part-time lecturers represent an important supplement to the teaching done by researchers. Your role as part-time lecturer will also provide you with opportunities to update your theoretical knowledge, to share in discussions with ambitious students and to be part of an international academic environment.

The position is on a temporary (3 years) part-time basis, which can be extended within the framework of the Danish Fixed-Term Employment Act (Lov om tidsbegrænset ansættelse).

The position may include
• Planning and conducting teaching in Business & Government
• Planning and conducting teaching in Strategies of Multinational Corporations and Risk management
• Planning and conducting teaching in Policy-making
• Planning and conducting teaching in Political Science with an emphasis on Comparative Politics
• Online teaching—blended learning
• Student supervision
• Preparing teaching materials and exam questions
• Conducting exams and other evaluations
Qualifications
To fill this position, you are required to have a master’s degree and must have:
• High-level practical experience, which has not been gained through academic employment with a university, or
• Employment in an academic principal position with another university (e.g. as assistant professor/researcher, associate professor/senior researcher, or professor/professor with special responsibilities).
• A part-time lecturer who is employed on the merits of his or her relevant practical experience must possess in-depth, up-to-date knowledge of the possible applications of the subject/academic discipline. This knowledge is/has been acquired through employment within the subject/academic discipline.
Other skills
• In addition to having a relevant master’s degree, emphasis is placed on your specialization and professional skills within the content of the respective courses covered by the department
• You possess good collaboration skills and the ability to contribute to a good working environment
• Proficiency in both Danish and English as teaching is conducted in both Danish and English
• It is an advantage to hold a PhD in a relevant disciplineThe conditions of employment and the qualification requirements are described further in the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities.

Terms of employment
Salary and employment will be in accordance with the Cirkulære om aftale om Eksterne lektorer ved universiteter m.fl. under Uddannelses- og Forskningsministeriet. The maximum number of working hours per academic year is 500 and may vary as needed in individual semesters. Remuneration is based on the number of hours, which is determined twice a year.

When employed as a part-time lecturer you must take an introductory course on university teaching organised by CBS.
You will be assigned a researcher at the department as your professional contact person. You are expected to participate in professional events relevant to your teaching and you will also be part of the department’s network of part-time lecturers.

The recruitment process
Copenhagen Business School invites all qualified candidates to apply for the position. An appointment committee will review the applications and invite a selection of qualified candidates to an interview.
One of CBS’ strategic goals is the promotion of diversity, which is why every effort has been made to ensure a recruitment process that reduces potential bias. Applicants are therefore encouraged not to include a photo or unnecessary personal information in their application.

Further information
If you would like to know more about the position, please do not hesitate to contact Head of Department Jens Gammelgaard, jg.egb@cbs.dk
Interviews are expected to be held at the beginning of January, 2027.

Søg stillingen

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Metabolomics and Metabolite Imaging at Cellular Resolution
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Environmental Science programme. The position is available from 01 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title:
Metabolite Imaging at Cellular Resolution

Research area and project description:
This project will develop advanced methods and open-source tools for processing, analysing and interpreting MSI and spatial metabolomics data, particularly for small molecules metabolites at cellular resolution. The methods will be applied to tissue sections, microbial communities, environmental samples to understand spatial control of metabolites and their flux in an organ system.

The successful candidate will work at the interface of computational science, biochemistry, microbiology and analytical chemistry. The project will combine analytical and computational method development with experimental spatial metabolomics workflow combining MALDI-MS, tissue staining and microscopic imaging. The PhD student will join an interdisciplinary team of chemists, microbiologists, biologists and computational scientists and contribute to both methodological development and biological applications.

The position includes:
• Developing mass spectrometry imaging workflows to achieve cellular resolution.
• Integrating various imaging and staining modalities with MSI.
• Collaborating with computational scientists and biologists to validate methods against experimental and biological datasets. Ensure reliable implementation of automated quality control, testing, documentation and reproducibility reporting.
• Communicating computational results clearly to interdisciplinary and non-computational researchers. Processing and analysing imaging datasets and presenting results at internal and international scientific meetings.
• Publishing methodological and application studies and releasing well-documented open-source soft-ware.
• Close supervision and collaboration with dedicated researchers and senior investigators.
Qualifications and specific competences:
We are seeking highly motivated candidates with a strong interest in interdisciplinary research. Applicants should hold a master’s degree (or equivalent) in computer science, bioinformatics/ cheminformatics, AI/ML, da-ta science, chemistry, computational biology, chemometrics, analytical chemistry or a related discipline.

Essential qualifications:
• Solid background in analytical chemistry, biotechnology, mass spectrometry, omics data analysis and/or mass spectrometry
• Strong interest in spatial metabolomics and its applications
Desirable qualifications:
• Experience with mass spectrometry, microscopy, microbial systems, or analytical chemistry
• Ability to work independently as well as in collaborative, interdisciplinary teams
 Place of employment and place of work:
Aarhus University, Department of Environmental Science, Roskilde Campus, Frederiksborgvej 399, Building 74124000 Roskilde, Denmark

jobs.occupation: PhD fellowship/scholarship - Integration of view-out quality and privacy assessment in building design activities
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Civil and Architectural Engineering programme. The position is available from 1 February 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title:
Integration of view-out quality and privacy assessment in building design activities

Research area and project description:
The aim of this Ph.D. project is to develop methods for designing facades and surrounding landscapes with a regenerative environmental impact under future climate scenarios. The objective is to develop a model that predicts occupants’ satisfaction with view-out quality and visual privacy for different combinations of façade and landscape design, and to integrate it into existing indoor environmental quality (IEQ) models. Combined with assessments of material use and life-cycle environmental impacts, the model will help designers identify solutions that offer the best trade-offs between maximising occupant satisfaction and minimising the material demand and environmental impacts of the building and landscape elements. The hypothesis is that façade and landscape designs which achieve higher occupant satisfaction with both view-out quality and visual privacy are less likely to be altered in response to dissatisfaction with either aspect. This resilience is expected to extend the functional longevity of the original design and reduce the additional material use and environmental impacts associated with such alterations.

The methodological approach to establish the model will be a combination of user perception experiments on the perception of view quality and visual privacy through windows in facade systems in both lab experiments and field studies. Co-creation techniques are applied to engage with the building industry to integrate and test the model in practical design methods and workflows for climate-resilient design of buildings under future climate scenarios.
The background for the project is that the planetary boundaries are overstepped due to excessive environmental load from human activities, which means that humanity has entered a zone of risk of deleterious or even catastrophic environmental change at continental to global scales. The main driver for this is the built environment that e.g. accounts for approx. 43% of all energy-related CO2-emissions. There is therefore an acute need to reduce the environmental load from the built environment to a level that enables the regenerative properties of the planetary ecosystems to reestablish the safe operating space below the planetary boundaries.

Qualifications and specific competences:
The candidate must have an M.Sc. degree or similar in architectural engineering. Applicants are expected to have at least five years of experience from building design practice. Documented experience in digital building modelling and practical experience in user involvement processes is mandatory. Experience with evaluation of view-out quality and privacy in design practice is preferred.

jobs.occupation: Lastbilchauffør til fødevarevirksomhed / Truck driver for foodservice company
jobs.description:
Lastbilchauffør til fødevarevirksomhed.

Friske og energiske lastbilchauffør kollegaer søges hos fødevare virksomhed.

Vi er en fødevare virksomhed som søger medarbejdere med lyst til at levere stykgods til en bred vifte af restauratører på hele Sjælland.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst og søger hele tiden nye arbejdsområder og har derfor brug for flere dygtige lastbilchauffører, der kan indgå i teams med mange forskellige kolleger.

 

Lastbilchauffører til et mangfoldigt og sundt arbejdsmiljø

Som medarbejder hos os får du en tempofyldt hverdag med mange opgaver. Sammen med dine kolleger skal du sørge for, at leverancerne bliver udført på de aftalte tidspunkter.

 

Opgaver

-          når du møder ind, sikre dig at din lastvogn er pakket og klar til afgang

-          opsamle de nødvendige dokumenter til brug for leverancerne

-          levere stykgods til de aftalte kunder

-          andre ad. hoc lager-/ chaufføropgaver

Din udvikling i din stilling, samt muligheder for forbedringer er noget vi holder øje med, så vi hele tiden kan skabe et fælles og godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor orden, kvalitet og automatisering er i fokus.

 

Engagement & fleksibilitet

Du har muligvis erfaring med lager- eller logistikarbejde fra en tidligere stilling. Vi søger både kolleger med og uden truckcertifikat. Det er vigtigt, at du er fleksibel og trives godt med at arbejde i et dynamisk miljø, hvor vi lægger vægt på nøjagtighed og kvalitet.

Du er god til at prioritere og planlægge dine opgaver selvstændigt, og det falder dig lige så nemt at arbejde sammen med andre/et team om fælles at løse opgaverne. 

Fortrukne sprogkundskaber i prioriteret orden;

1. Tyrkisk          2. Kurdisk         3. Dansk            4. Engelsk

 

Løn

Løn aftales ifht. kvalifikationer. Som minimum aflønnes på baggrund af fælles overenskomst mellem DI Overenskomst II og 3F Fagligt Fælles Forbund, Transportgruppen - for lagerarbejdere, chauffører og havnearbejdere.

 

Krav

·         Du har et gyldigt kørekort C.

·         Du har allerede et gyldigt EU-bevis og førerkort eller vil opnå dette for at tiltræde stillingen.

Send din ansøgning og CV til job@megahouse.dk, markeret med ”Lastbilchauffør” i emnefeltet, så kontakter vi dig, hvis du opfylder kriterierne som kandidat til jobbet.

(ENG)

Truck driver for foodservice company

Fresh and energetic truck driver colleagues are wanted for a foodservice company.

We are a foodservice company who is seeking for employees who want to deliver bulk goods to a wide range of restaurateurs throughout Zealand.

We are a growing company and are constantly looking for new areas of work and therefore need more skilled truck drivers who can join the team with many different colleagues.

 

Truck drivers for a diverse and healthy working environment

As an employee with us, you will have a fast-paced everyday life with many tasks. Together with your colleagues, you must ensure that the deliveries are carried out at the agreed times.

 

Assignments

-          When you arrive, make sure your lorry is packed and ready for departure

-          Collect the necessary documents for use in the deliveries

-          Deliver piece goods to agreed customers/destinations

-          Other ad. hoc warehouse/driver tasks

Your development in your position, as well as opportunities for improvement, is something we keep an eye on, so that we can constantly create common and good working environment, where order, quality and automation are the focus.

 

Commitment & flexibility

You may have experience with warehouse or logistics work from a previous position. We are looking for colleagues with and without a truck certificate. It is important that you are flexible and enjoy working in a dynamic environment where we emphasize accuracy and quality.

You are good at prioritizing and planning your tasks independently, and it is just as easy for you to work together with others/a team to jointly solve the tasks.

Preferred language skills in priority order;

1. Turkish          2. Kurdish         3. Danish          4. English

 

Salary

Salary is agreed according to qualifications. As a minimum, wages are paid on the basis of a joint agreement between DI Overenskomst II and 3F Fagligt Fælles Forbund, the transport group – for warehouse workers, drivers and port workers.

 

Requirements

·         You have a valid driving license C.

·         You already have a valid EU driving licence or will obtain this to fill the position.

Send your application and CV to job@megahouse.dk, marked with “Truck driver” in the subject field and we will contact you if meet the criteria as a candidate for the job.

jobs.occupation: Lastbilchauffør (C/CE) / Truck Driver (C/CE)– Stabrand Spedition, Nordhavn
jobs.description:
Lastbilchauffører søges til Stabrand Spedition i Nordhavn

Vi søger flere lastbilchauffører til vores kørselsafdeling med udgangspunkt fra Skagerrakvej 8, 2150 Nordhavn.

Hos Stabrand Spedition får du en hverdag, hvor dagene ikke nødvendigvis ligner hinanden. Vi kører både stykgods, part loads, full loads samt skibscontainere på chassis og med sideloader, primært på Sjælland.

Du får som udgangspunkt fast tilknyttet bil, som du har ansvar for i det daglige. Du bliver samtidig en del af et godt chaufførteam, hvor man hjælper hinanden, taler ordentligt sammen og har tæt kontakt med vores disponenter.

Arbejdsdagen

Arbejdsdagen starter normalt omkring kl. 06.00-06.30 i Nordhavn.

Opgaverne varierer efter, hvad der skal køres den pågældende dag. Det kan være stykgods den ene dag, part- eller full load den næste og containerkørsel en tredje.

Derudover følger de almindelige chaufføropgaver selvfølgelig med: af- og pålæsning, lastsikring, håndtering af trailer og containere, dokumenter samt almindelig kontrol og pasning af bilen og udstyret.

Vi leder efter dig, der er mødestabil, tager ansvar for dit arbejde og kan arbejde selvstændigt. Du skal passe ordentligt på bilen og materiellet og være indstillet på, at planen nogle gange ændrer sig i løbet af dagen.

Som chauffør er du ofte den person fra Stabrand Spedition, som vores kunder møder. Derfor betyder det også noget for os, at du er ordentlig i din omgang med kunderne og repræsenterer virksomheden på en god måde.

Engelsk er et krav. Dansk er en fordel, men ikke nødvendigt.

Har du erfaring med containerkørsel, stykgods eller anden godskørsel, er det selvfølgelig en fordel.

Kørekort og certifikater

Når du søger, vil vi gerne have et klart overblik over, hvad du har af kørekort og beviser.

·   dine kørekortkategorier og udløbsdato

·   eventuelt chaufføruddannelsesbevis / EU-kvalifikationsbevis og udløbsdato

·   førerkort til digital takograf og udløbsdato

·   eventuelt ADR-bevis

·   eventuelt krancertifikat

·   andre relevante certifikater eller uddannelser

ADR og krancertifikat er en fordel, men ikke et krav til alle vores opgaver.

Hvad får du hos os?

Du får en fuldtidsstilling med udgangspunkt i Nordhavn, primært kørsel på Sjælland, forskellige typer transportopgaver og en fast tilknyttet bil.

Du bliver en del af en virksomhed, hvor transport hænger tæt sammen med vores terminal-, lager- og 3PL-aktiviteter. Det giver en hverdag med mange forskellige typer opgaver og korte veje mellem chauffører, disponenter og resten af organisationen.

Ansøgning

Send os en kort ansøgning eller præsentation af dig selv sammen med dit CV på tobias@stabrand.dk eller ring på 39209030 for spørgsmål vedrørende stillingen.

Husk at angive dine kørekortkategorier, udløbsdatoer og relevante certifikater.

Vi indkalder løbende relevante kandidater til samtale.

***ENGLISH BELOW***

Truck Drivers Wanted for Stabrand Spedition in Nordhavn

We are looking for additional truck drivers to join our transport department, based at Skagerrakvej 8, 2150 Nordhavn.

At Stabrand Spedition, no two days are necessarily the same. We handle groupage, part loads, full loads and shipping containers on chassis and sideloaders, mainly across Zealand.

As a general rule, you will have a truck assigned to you and be responsible for it in your day-to-day work. You will also join a good team of drivers where people help each other, communicate properly and work closely with our dispatchers.

The working day

The working day normally starts around 06:00-06:30 in Nordhavn.

The jobs vary depending on what needs to be transported that day. One day may involve groupage, the next a part or full load, and another day container transport.

The usual driver duties are naturally part of the job as well: loading and unloading, securing cargo, handling trailers and containers, paperwork, and normal daily checks and care of the truck and equipment.

We are looking for someone who turns up on time, takes responsibility for the job and is comfortable working independently. You should take good care of the truck and equipment and be prepared for plans to change during the day from time to time.

As a driver, you are often the person from Stabrand Spedition our customers meet. It therefore matters to us that you deal with customers properly and represent the company in a professional and positive way.

English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Experience with container transport, groupage or other types of goods transport is an advantage.

Driving licence and certificates

When applying, please give us a clear overview of your driving licence and certificates.

·   your driving licence categories and expiry date

·   any driver qualification card / EU Certificate of Professional Competence and expiry date

·   digital tachograph driver card and expiry date

·   any ADR certificate

·   any crane certificate

·   other relevant certificates or qualifications

ADR and crane certificates are an advantage, but they are not required for all of our assignments.

What we offer

This is a full-time position based in Nordhavn, with driving mainly across Zealand, a varied mix of transport assignments and, a truck assigned to you only.

You will join a company where transport works closely together with our terminal, warehouse and 3PL activities. This creates a varied working day and short lines of communication between drivers, dispatchers and the rest of the organisation.

Application

Send us a short application or introduction together with your CV to tobias@stabrand.dk or contact us via +45 39209030 for questions regarding the position.

Please remember to include your driving licence categories, expiry dates and relevant certificates.

We invite suitable candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

jobs.occupation: Team Leader for Demolition Company
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and responsible Team Leader to join our demolition division.

As a Team Leader, you will be responsible for a team of 3-5 employees and ensure that daily tasks are planned and carried out efficiently, safely, and to a high standard of quality. You should be able to lead by example, motivate team members, and contribute to a positive working environment.

Key Responsibilities

· Plan and allocate daily work tasks.

· Train and mentor new employees.

· Ensure compliance with all relevant safety regulations and quality standards.

jobs.occupation: Regional Director – Nordics & Baltics | Successful International Group
jobs.description:
About the Company

Our client is a successful international distributor of specialty chemicals, with operations across a number of international markets and a presence in more than 20 countries.

The group holds a strong international position and is currently working to strengthen its presence and drive further growth in the Nordics and Baltics.

You will become a pivotal part of an international organization, with excellent opportunities to influence development and shape the direction of future commercial growth.

About the Position

As Regional Director – Nordics & Baltics, you will have overall responsibility for the business unit's development, performance, and future direction in the region.

Your primary task will be to set the strategic direction and ensure the continuous development of the business. You will play a central role in translating the group's ambitions into concrete goals and results, as well as creating the organizational and commercial framework for future growth.

In close collaboration with the Sales Director, you will develop and implement the strategy for the region and ensure progress through clear leadership, prioritization, and strong cooperation with the rest of the organization.

You will establish direction and engagement within the organization, develop leaders and employees, and ensure that the right competencies and resources are brought into play. The role requires the ability to deliver results through others while maintaining a strategic overview and an understanding of the business's commercial opportunities.

Your Primary Responsibilities

• Develop leaders and employees with a focus on competencies, engagement, accountability, and collaboration.

• Translate the group's overall ambitions into concrete strategies, goals, and action plans.

• Support a company culture characterized by initiative, ownership, openness, and continuous development.

About You

You have leadership experience and a strong strategic understanding. You possess the ability to gain commitment, set direction, and develop an organization through clear leadership, involvement, and trust.

You do not necessarily need to have held a director-level position previously. The most important thing is that you have the ambition, the strategic overview, and the ability to take overall responsibility for a business unit's development and results.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience in commercial leadership and organizational development, including developing and implementing strategies and translating them into concrete goals and results.

• Are a clear leader who sets direction, builds engagement, and ensures progress.

• Thrive with overall responsibility and are able to maintain both the strategic overview and an understanding of the organization's daily operations.

• Are a modern leader who believes in freedom with responsibility and is motivated by coaching and facilitating rather than micromanaging.

• Have experience in developing people and achieving results through others.

• Possess a good financial understanding and the ability to make decisions on a sound strategic and financial basis.

• Have experience from the specialty chemicals industry or related sectors. This will be considered an advantage.

• Communicate effortlessly in both Danish and English. Additional language skills are an advantage.

What Is Offered

• A central leadership position with responsibility for an international business unit that is part of a successful global group.

• A commercial mandate with the opportunity to influence strategy and organization and leave a clear mark on the development of the Nordics and Baltics.

• A dynamic working environment combining strategic responsibility, leadership, and organizational development.

• Business travel in connection with the development of the business in the Nordics and Baltics, with significant influence over your own travel planning.

Workplace: Aarhus area.

You can be based anywhere in Denmark, as there are good opportunities for remote work. If you live outside daily commuting distance, you will be expected to work from the office approximately once a week.

Application

We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to upload your CV as soon as possible.

Please upload your CV and, optionally, a short cover letter using the Apply for the Position button.

The job advertisement will be removed once the position has been filled.

All inquiries and applications will, of course, be treated confidentially.

Want to Know More?

You are welcome to contact Carsten Lindberg Hartvigsen by phone at +45 41 81 34 00 if you have any questions regarding the position.

carsten@lindberghr.dk

Reporting to the Director, Innovation PMO, you will work closely with colleagues across the PMO and senior stakeholders across Ambu.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of in-person collaboration and focused individual work. That's why this role is based in Augsburg or Ballerup and follows a hybrid working model, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home.

Key responsibilities

• 
Cross-functional initiatives

• 
Drive selected cross-functional topics from problem definition through analysis, recommendation and stakeholder alignment.

Define decisions, actions and ownership, and hand over execution to the relevant business owner.

• 
Portfolio governance and ways of working

Analysis and decision support

Management support

• Have relevant experience within project portfolio management, management consulting, PMO, business transformation or operational excellence.

• Have taken complex, cross-functional business problems from initial question to analysis, recommendation and agreed action.

• Have aligned senior stakeholders across functions, including situations with different priorities and no direct reporting relationship.

jobs.occupation: Senior Partnerships Account Manager
jobs.description:
Help grow Awaze’s commercial footprint across Germany, Austria and Switzerland by building high-performing travel agency relationships and strategic partnerships that bring our holidays to even more guests.

**Your mission

**As our new Senior Partnership Account Manager, your mission is to grow Awaze’s commercial footprint across the DACH region through two interconnected areas: developing our travel agency channel and building strategic commercial partnerships.

As you’ll be working directly with travel agencies and partners across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, you’ll need to be fluent in German, at native or near-native level, as well as confident communicating professionally in English.

You’ll own and grow relationships with travel agencies across the region, lead agencies through the transition from legacy booking systems to Awaze’s modern platform, and identify new opportunities to expand our network. Alongside this, you’ll develop strategic partnerships from initial prospecting and negotiation through to onboarding and ongoing account development.

Working closely with Marketing, Product, Commercial and leadership teams, you’ll use market insight and performance data to strengthen partner engagement, extend Awaze’s reach and deliver measurable commercial impact.

**What You'll Be Doing

**

• Own and develop relationships with travel agencies across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, with a particular focus on chains and networks.

• Lead the end-to-end transition of agencies from legacy booking systems to Awaze’s modern platform, including change management, training and onboarding.

• Identify, develop and onboard new travel agency partners, maintaining a strong pipeline of prospective agencies.

• Proactively identify, pursue, negotiate and close new strategic commercial partnerships across the DACH region.

• Manage the full partnership lifecycle, from initial outreach and commercial negotiation through to onboarding and ongoing account development.

• Monitor agency and partnership performance, using data and commercial metrics to identify opportunities for increased adoption, engagement and growth.

• Collaborate with Marketing, Product and Commercial teams to ensure partners are effectively supported and positioned for success.

• Identify co-marketing and co-branding opportunities that create mutual value and extend Awaze’s reach and brand presence.

• Act as a source of DACH market intelligence, sharing relevant trends, partner feedback and commercial insights with leadership and product teams.

• Travel regularly across the DACH region to build and strengthen relationships with agencies and strategic partners.

**Who We’re Looking For

**You’ll thrive in this role if you’re a natural relationship builder who enjoys turning commercial opportunities into long-term, mutually valuable partnerships. You’re comfortable taking ownership of a varied portfolio, confident working independently and equally at home discussing performance data, negotiating a new partnership or helping an established agency embrace a new way of working.

Fluent German, at native or near-native level, is an essential requirement for this role. You’ll use German regularly to build trusted relationships and communicate effectively with travel agencies and strategic partners across the DACH region.

**We’re Looking For Someone Who Brings

**

• Several years of experience in account management, partnerships or business development, ideally within travel, hospitality or a related sector.

• A demonstrable track record of growing accounts and closing partnerships that deliver measurable commercial outcomes.

• Fluent German, at native or near-native level, alongside strong professional English, both written and spoken.

• Strong relationship-building, communication and presentation skills, with the credibility to engage agency owners, commercial partners and senior stakeholders.

• Strong analytical capabilities and confidence using performance data and commercial metrics to inform decisions and identify opportunities.

• An understanding of brand and marketing principles and the ability to represent Awaze consistently with external partners.

• A self-motivated and structured approach, with the ability to independently manage a large and varied account portfolio.

• Willingness and ability to travel regularly across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, as well as other locations when required.

• Bonus points if you have experience within the DACH travel agency landscape, legacy travel booking systems or digital platform transitions, or have worked within or alongside a major European travel group.

• An established network across DACH travel agencies or hospitality chains, or experience with GDS tools and partnership management platforms, would also be an advantage.

**How You'll Make An Impact

**

• Successfully transition and onboard travel agencies onto Awaze’s modern platform, driving strong adoption and engagement.

• Grow the number, quality and performance of active travel agency relationships across the DACH region.

• Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective agencies and strategic partners, progressing opportunities through to successful commercial agreements.

• Strengthen retention, satisfaction and commercial performance across your agency and partnership portfolio.

• Turn performance data into clear insights and recommendations that help both our partners and internal teams make better commercial decisions.

• Work across Marketing, Product and Commercial teams to unlock partner support, co-marketing opportunities and additional commercial value.

• Bring relevant DACH market trends, partner feedback and insights into Awaze to help inform product and business decisions.

• Champion Awaze’s brands and standards across every agency and partner interaction.

**Why you’ll want to work at Awaze

**We offer a versatile position in a strong professional and social environment - one you’ll have the opportunity to influence and help shape. You’ll be part of an international company that invests in the future, and join a dynamic, fast-paced department with skilled and committed colleagues who support each other.

We’re a People-first Business - And We Know That Our Success Starts With Our Teams. Here’s a Glimpse Of What You’ll Enjoy

• Generous discounts on holidays across our brands

• Flexible hybrid working – with the autonomy to work how you work best

• Real opportunities to grow, learn and shape your role as well as careers progression vertically or horizontally, cross countries and responsibilities.

**About Awaze

**Our mission is clear - to create amazing holidays with Europe’s widest choice of holiday homes.

With more than 110,000 properties across Europe, we are the largest managed vacation rentals business in the region. Our ambition is not only to be the biggest, but the best provider of holiday homes in Europe.

As travel continues to evolve, we are focused on what comes next. We will keep strengthening our relationships with guests and homeowners, continuously improving the way we work, and delivering strong performance. By making things simpler and smarter, we are building a business that is ready for what’s next - powered by proud, passionate and inclusive people.

**Worth knowing

**

• This role can be based remotely in Germany or from our Virum office in Denmark.

• Regular travel across Germany, Austria and Switzerland will be an important part of the role, with travel to other locations when required.

**What’s next?

**If this sounds like the right next step for you, hit “Apply” and follow the instructions to submit your application. We tailor our recruitment process to each role to give both you and our hiring teams the best possible chance to assess whether this could be the start of a successful collaboration. You’ll hear from us shortly after we’ve reviewed your application.

We’re committed to running an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment, and if you have any specific requirements or adjustments needed for the interview, just let us know when you accept your invitation - we’re happy to accommodate.
